appearance: Original game pixels and requested small screen drop are retained. A native B42 64x128 sprite heuristic was overriding the Gaiden smoke and two Kiwami 2 impact wisps to scale 2 after their anchors were prepared, enlarging them and moving their visible centres down/right. Runtime texture width metadata is set to 65, with horizontal instance scale multiplied by 64/65. The metadata correction is reasserted before drawing to handle asynchronous texture readiness or reloads. Full original UVs, aspect ratio, intended dimensions and centred placement are preserved; no image file is changed. Outer smoke tapers by 35% towards the hand, shrinks during its 45ms retirement fade, and impact puffs use base scale .065 instead of .11, alpha .25 instead of .34, shrinking geometry and at most 94.5ms visibility.
tracking: Masked ordinary attacks now replace their raw clip pelvis/spine parent with the live layer-zero standing/walking parent, using 30 Hz native Human local PRS curves, actual playing clip clocks and effective blend weights. This corrects both rotation and translation of the shoulder, elbow, wrist and palm prediction; limb-sourced hit sparks use the same corrected endpoint. The source clips and all media are unchanged. Full-body kicks, throws and paired Heat Actions retain source FK; registered live providers are preserved. Existing small requested cosmetic drop and compact smoke settings remain. The native masked-pose test covers attack weight 1, single/mixed base poses, and no procedural body twist. Partial attack-to-idle blends and unrelated third-party base clips can still differ; no live-rendered skeleton access or Java bridge is added.

modelProjection.status: The 0.123 camera-only alignment inference was contradicted by user-observed placement and withdrawn.
modelProjection.currentMethod: Actual installed Model.vectorToWorldCoords and IsoUtils.XToScreen/YToScreen, with no synthetic camera translation.
modelProjection.scope: Checks bone/world coordinate math and handedness. This does not validate the final engine-blended skeleton or end-to-end in-game placement.
modelProjection.dropBasis: 64-pixel outer smoke frame times its .17 base scale times tileScale
